description: Substitution table for instantiating generic proof-skills templates against the EASCI codebase. Consumed by templates_to_md.py and other instantiators.

scale.rationale: Simplex / probability quantities live in Nat × 100 so kernel-checkable Decidable proofs stay tractable.  Explicit casts to ℝ only at analysis boundaries (Lyapunov, cusp, contraction).
scale.cast_hint: Use push_cast for Nat → ℝ; coords appear as (x : Nat) / 100 : ℝ.
